newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves surplus power offers unchanged for Mon.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves surplus power offers unchanged for Mon.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer only off-peak power for pre-scheduled sales on Saturday and Monday, the agency said Friday.
BPA did offer power during heavy-load hours on Sunday (hours ending 0900-2200 PT) at $16.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $17.00 per MWh at the California-Oregon border (COB).

BPA continued to offer non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PDT on Monday at $9.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and COB deliveries, while delivered prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were flat at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Monday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
